understanding.goal_understanding: Navigate through each level, modify the carried piece's shape, color, and rotation as needed, and step onto every goal cell only when all three attributes match its requirements. Completing all goals advances through the levels and winning all levels completes the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each move costs one stamina, while blocked moves waste a turn and stamina without changing position. Blocked directions must be avoided using the provided blocked_directions state. Shape modifiers cycle shapes 0–5, color modifiers cycle orange → blue → green → red → orange, and rotation modifiers rotate clockwise through 0°, 90°, 180°, and 270°. Stamina reaching zero costs a life and resets stamina; losing all lives ends the game. An activated goal still requires physically stepping onto its cell to complete it.
